name: Hayden Valley Foods
old_description: From roasting and coating to mixing, packaging and distribution - we bring snack and confection manufacturing together under one roof so you can move faster, simplify sourcing, and deliver with confidence.
about:
Hayden Valley Foods operates from Urbancrest, Ohio, where it was founded in 1966 by Garland Williamson. The company remains family-owned, having grown from a relationship-driven business across the South into a large-scale snack and confection manufacturing partner.

The 150,000-square-foot facility integrates roasting, coating and enrobing, mixing and custom blending, packaging, distribution, and product development under one roof. Capabilities include nut and snack ingredient roasting, chocolate and yogurt coatings, trail mix formulation, and flexible retail and foodservice packaging, supporting scalable batch production for high-volume programs.

The company serves brands, retailers, distributors, and private-label partners in the snack and confection sectors. Its offerings span bulk ingredient supply, private label manufacturing, branded snack programs, and seasonal and gifting solutions, with end-to-end supply chain support from concept to shelf.

Hayden Valley Foods emphasizes family-owned accountability, integrity, and partnership as its differentiators. The company combines those values with modern production systems and certified quality standards—SQF, BC Probiotic, Kosher, and FDA registration—to deliver consistency and speed from idea to commercialization.
